meta.decisionGenerator: node:crypto randomInt (plan drawn up front and stored in meta.plan; in-round choices drawn at play time and stored on the round)

/road/fairness.derivation: block_i = HMAC_SHA256(key = serverSeed, message = clientSeed:nonce:i). Trap i of a round (i = 0, 1, …) is bytes 4i..4i+3 of block_0 ‖ block_1 ‖ … read as a big-endian number u; it is the slot at position floor(u × (25 − i) / 2^32) among the slots not yet picked, kept in ascending order — the same as floor(float × (25 − i)) with float = Σ byte_j / 256^(j+1), the derivation public Mines calculators use on 25 tiles. A round of difficulty m is the first m picks. Lane L (1-based) is deadly iff slot L − 1 is a trap; slots at or past the lanes count lie behind the castle gate and are never walked.
rules: a difficulty of easy, medium, hard or daredevil (1, 3, 5 or 10 traps on 25 slots)
the trap slots are fixed by the seed pair and the nonce before the first lane is walked
a trap ends the round and pays nothing
after at least one safe lane the round can be cashed out; crossing the last lane reaches the castle and cashes out by itself
a bet may name a number of lanes to walk: they are stepped in order and a round that meets no trap is cashed out at once
a round never pays more than its max win above the stake: a step that would take the cash-out value past it is not taken
a payout is rounded down to the wallet's smallest unit (1e-8) once
a round left without a decision for 24 hours is finished by the server: with lanes crossed it is cashed out at its value; with none, one lane is walked and, if it is safe, the round is cashed out
/road/fairness.multiplier: after k safe lanes on 25 slots with m traps a stake is paid × 99/100 × C(25, k) / C(25 − m, k)
/road/fairness.return: 99% for every difficulty and every stopping rule: C(25 − m, k) / C(25, k) is the chance that k lanes are all safe
/road/fairness.summary: block_i = HMAC_SHA256(key = serverSeed, message = clientSeed:nonce:i). Trap i of a round (i = 0, 1, …) is bytes 4i..4i+3 of block_0 ‖ block_1 ‖ … read as a big-endian number u; it is the slot at position floor(u × (25 − i) / 2^32) among the slots not yet picked, kept in ascending order — the same as floor(float × (25 − i)) with float = Σ byte_j / 256^(j+1), the derivation public Mines calculators use on 25 tiles. A round of difficulty m is the first m picks. Lane L (1-based) is deadly iff slot L − 1 is a trap; slots at or past the lanes count lie behind the castle gate and are never walked. The payout after k safe lanes on 25 slots with m traps a stake is paid × 99/100 × C(25, k) / C(25 − m, k), so the game returns 99% for every difficulty and every stopping rule: C(25 − m, k) / C(25, k) is the chance that k lanes are all safe. The server seed is committed up front by its SHA-256 hash and revealed when you rotate the pair, so every trap of a round is fixed before the bet and can be checked afterwards.
